purpose: P-001..P-060 capability -> named verification scenario mapping for the v0.2.0 tag gate (chunk #99). Validated by `cargo xtask verify:capability-matrix` (all ids present, every file ref exists, every `contains` anchor greps non-empty).

scenario_kinds.nextest-file: Rust test file executed by cargo nextest (crate colocated mod tests, crates/*/tests, or pulse-app/tests). NOTE: pulse-app/src colocated tests do NOT run ([lib] test = false) and are never referenced here.
scenario_kinds.ui-test: vitest *.test.{ts,tsx} under pulse-app/ui/src executed by `npm test`.
scenario_kinds.a11y-spec: Playwright spec under pulse-app/ui/tests-a11y executed by `cargo xtask test:a11y`.
scenario_kinds.ci-script: Gate script under xtask/ci/ executed against agent-latest.jsonl.
scenario_kinds.xtask-gate: cargo xtask subcommand acting as the verification gate.
scenario_kinds.source-evidence: Non-test source file where the capability's surface manifests; supplements but never solely satisfies a capability.
scenario_kinds.by-construction: Capability holds structurally (no code path exists that could violate it); notes field carries the justification.
